delete_task.description: Deletes a task by its task ID, removing its uploaded images and results from ABBYY.
delete_task.name: delete_task

get_application_info.description: Gets your ABBYY Cloud OCR application's name, remaining page credits and expiry date. Must be enabled in the ABBYY console first.
get_application_info.name: get_application_info

get_task_status.description: Gets a processing task by its task ID, including its status and, once finished, links to download the results.
get_task_status.name: get_task_status

list_finished_tasks.description: Lists the tasks that have finished processing and not yet been deleted, with each task's ID, status and result links.
list_finished_tasks.name: list_finished_tasks

list_tasks.description: Lists the recent processing tasks in your application, with each task's ID, status and creation time.
list_tasks.name: list_tasks

process_business_card.description: Starts reading the contact details on an uploaded business card image, in the languages and format you choose. Returns the task ID.
process_business_card.name: process_business_card

parameters.description: Choose the languages in the document. Leave empty to use the service’s default.
parameters.name: language

schema.description: Choose the languages in the document. Leave empty to use the service’s default.

process_document.description: Starts reading the text in all the images submitted to a task, by its task ID, in the languages and export format you choose. Returns the task.
process_document.name: process_document

parameters.description: Choose the languages in the document. Leave empty to use the service’s default.
parameters.name: language

options.label: Latvian language written in Gothic script

schema.description: Choose the languages in the document. Leave empty to use the service’s default.

process_image.description: Starts reading the text in one uploaded image or PDF, in the languages and export format you choose. Returns the task ID to check with Get task status.
process_image.name: process_image

parameters.description: Choose the languages in the document. Leave empty to use the service’s default.
parameters.name: language

options.label: Latvian language written in Gothic script

schema.description: Choose the languages in the document. Leave empty to use the service’s default.

process_mrz.description: Starts reading the machine-readable zone of an uploaded passport or ID card image. Returns the task ID to check with Get task status.
process_mrz.name: process_mrz

process_text_field.description: Starts reading the text in a single small image of one text field. Returns the task ID to check with Get task status.
process_text_field.name: process_text_field

submit_image.description: Uploads an image to a new or existing task, by task ID, so several pages can be processed together with Process document.
submit_image.name: submit_image

description: Recognize document text, business cards and machine-readable zones with ABBYY Cloud OCR SDK.

abbyy_task_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a task changes in ABBYY. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

abbyy_task_completed_trigger.description: Runs each time a task is completed in ABBYY. Ones completed before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
